tenant.label: Account (tenant)

form.name: Name *

form.logoHint: Recommended: square image of at least 400×400 px (PNG or JPG).
form.uploadHint: Drag an image or click to choose

form.templateHint: This template will be applied to all menus of this business
form.additionalCurrenciesHint: Click the currencies you want to accept in addition to the default currency

alerts.missingTenantMessage: Choose which account (tenant) the business should be created in.

qrNameModal.title: Name change and QR code
qrNameModal.body: Warning: if you change the business name, the QR code and public link may no longer match material you already printed or shared. Anyone using an old QR or link may see an error or a different page.
qrNameModal.confirmHint: To confirm you understand the consequences, type exactly the following word in uppercase (no spaces):

qrModal.title: QR code - {{name}}
qrModal.scanHint: Scan this QR code to view the business on your mobile device
qrModal.noSlug: Cannot generate the QR. Make sure the business has a slug.

limitModal.title: Limit reached
limitModal.reached: You have reached the limit of {{limit}} business(es) for your {{plan}} plan.
limitModal.needMoreBody: Upgrade your subscription to create more businesses and unlock all AppMenuQR features.

transferModal.title: Transfer business
transferModal.introWithAccount: You are about to move {{name}} (current account: {{tenant}}) with all its menus and products to another user's account.
transferModal.introNoAccount: You are about to move {{name}} with all its menus and products to another user's account.
transferModal.bulletQr: The business link and QR do not change.
transferModal.bulletLimits: If the destination plan has an active product limit, excess products will be deactivated.
transferModal.bulletUser: The destination user must have an active account with a tenant (not a super admin).
transferModal.noUsers: No matching users. Try a different search term.

deleteModal.title: Delete Business
deleteModal.body: Are you sure you want to delete this business? This action cannot be undone and all associated menus and products will also be deleted.
